verdict.rationale: First-party docs say AnythingLLM runs entirely on your computer with no accounts or API keys. Community hands-on reports confirm offline use and automatic Ollama detection, so the core local-only story is supported. Coverage is not complete because only one of the four named backends is evidenced. missing for 10: documented support for llama.cpp, LM Studio, and vLLM backends; first-party docs listing the local model providers and confirming no cloud model fallback or dependency.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, I can run the assistant entirely on local models — Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, or vLLM — with no cloud model dependency

citations.quote: A private AI assistant that runs entirely on your computer. No accounts, no API keys, no token limits.
Every document becomes part of your agent's knowledge base with no data leaving your device.
With Ollama, everything was automatically detected, while manual setup is still possible.
this has been the only offline AI tool I've been able to install and start using on my standard office PC.
